tournament_name: Arnold Palmer Invitational presented by Mastercard
comment: Because only one can be the captain, I typically avoid rostering both McIlroy and Scheffler, but the timing of the penultimate stop of Segment 1 defends the logic and strategy. With just one start remaining for Scheffler, he’s insurance at Bay Hill, if necessary, and I can run McIlroy back at THE PLAYERS regardless.

comment: You must play boldly to win, and I'm a sucker for a good floatie drill. Rolling with Hovland on a course where he has contended often but hasn't quite sealed the deal.

comment: The only two-time winner in the field, he says goodbye to Poa annua and hello to Bermuda. The horse for the course has earned T15 or better in all five visits, including the two victories. Feels like a no-brainer.

tournament_name: Arnold Palmer Invitational presented by Mastercard
comment: Taking a flier on a guy who has shown he can rise to the top on tough courses the last two seasons. He’s been quietly steady in 2026 and will peak at some point.

comment: Thought about getting cheeky and sticking Scheffler on my bench for the first round and avoiding any chance the Thursday blues continue. Alas, we’ll ride with him all week and bet he gets back on track.

comment: Saved my Scheffler picks for this Sunshine State run, so deploying accordingly on a track where he has dominated via approach play.
